rows.casts-a-creature-card-face-down-as-a-two: Oracle: with X paid, choose a creature card in hand whose mana cost the X mana could pay and cast it face down as a 2/2. Observed in gorge: the X choice is posed (X = 4) and taken, but no creature card is ever offered (the Hill Giant stays in hand). Corroboration: Forge casts the chosen Hill Giant face down as a 2/2; XMage does not implement Illusionary Mask, so this row is kept pending XMage support and is not one of the both-engine-corroborated rows.
